# Suede AI Skills

> Suede AI Skills gives founders, marketers, and small teams reusable workflows for SEO audits, AI search visibility, conversion copy, and business operations. Run them in Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, with instructions you can inspect and adapt to your business. Start with a page or business brief to get prioritized audit findings, positioning and campaign plans, or a map of operational bottlenecks. The pack also includes code review, app delivery, and creator-rights tools. Original work is MIT licensed; adapted components retain their upstream notices. Every skill is a plain Markdown SKILL.md folder. Read the skill-specific inputs, outputs, and scope before running it.

Maintained by Jason Colapietro (Suede AI, https://suedeai.ai), one author. These are the same skill folders that run the estate day to day, published as they are: open the folder and read the file. Repository: https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills. License and attribution details: https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills/blob/main/NOTICE.md. The GitHub Pages site is generated from the same repo, so the docs, the install commands, and the MCP source sit beside the skills they describe. October 2026: Suede AI is a member of Claude for Startups, Anthropic's startup program (https://claude.com/programs/startups).

Install for Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills` then `/plugin install suede-skills@suede`. Two commands, about thirty seconds. Focused subsets exist for narrower work, and they cost the same per skill because an unmatched skill never loads its body: `suede-marketing@suede` (41 skills for paid acquisition, outbound, pricing, offers, lifecycle, social growth, AI search optimization, attribution, and analytics), `suede-agent-workflows@suede` (orchestration, workflows, evals), and `suede-code@suede` (review, grade, ship-gate).

Install the full pack for Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills --ref main` then `codex plugin add suede-skills@suede-codex`. The plugin registers 1 read-only MCP server with 12 tools. For one skill only, use the built-in skill installer with `--repo JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills --path skills/<name>`.

Install from PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/suede-creator-skills/. With pipx installed, run `pipx install suede-creator-skills` then `suede-skills install` for Claude Code, or `suede-skills install --target codex` for Codex. The Python CLI requires Python 3.9 or newer and has no runtime dependencies. Existing skill folders are preserved unless `--force` is used. Python installation and upgrade instructions: https://skills.suedeai.ai/plugins.html.

Install on Hermes Agent (Nous Research): the repository is a skills tap. `hermes skills tap add JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills` subscribes to all of it; `hermes skills install JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills/skills/<name>` takes one skill without subscribing. Hermes downloads the whole skill folder, scans it, and exposes it as a `/skill-name` command. On Hermes the skill contracts install in full; the MCP server and the executable Suede Thought Graph workflow run in Claude Code and Codex.

Runner for Suede Graph Flo XR: the bundled Suede Thought Graph workflow runs on Claude Code for macOS with six registered `suede-graph-flo-xr-*` agent profiles, which the full Claude Code plugin, the `suede-agent-workflows` subset, and `install.sh` register for you. Codex, generic skills-CLI, and single-folder installs load the orchestration contract; install the six profiles in Claude Code to run the bundled Claude Workflow.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://skills.suedeai.ai/): The landing page. Two commands to install, the whole catalog, the FAQ, and the proof links behind each claim.
- [Full guide](https://skills.suedeai.ai/guide.html): The chain end to end. Plan the change, build it in lanes, grade the diff A to F where the weakest lane caps the grade, strip the slop out of the copy, then ship. Also covers the MCP server, install paths, and the FAQ; the complete list is on the skill index above.
- [Skill index](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/): Browse every skill.
- [Agent Skills Directory](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/): A curated index of 3,894 public Agent Skills (97% under an open-source or open-content license) from 163 other GitHub repositories, in 16 category directories. Every listing links to the author's repository, passes the Suede Skill Check's structural listing gate, shows a 0–99 quality score and letter grade, and states its license; the 1,791 skills scoring 80–99 offer numeric and letter README badges (either valid linked badge can qualify for verified promotion); security scan status is separately marked not scanned; full skill pages summarize the scripts, credentials and network calls found in the skill's files; [how skills are listed](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/methodology/). Edited by Jason Colapietro, Suede AI. Category directories:

The plan search caps at 55, 110, or 200 agent calls.
- [S-Tier, the book](https://skills.suedeai.ai/book/): A free book, roughly 29,900 words in 14 chapters, on how Agent Skills work and how a builder gets good with them. Every claim in it points at a file in this repo, so you can check it instead of believing it. Covers progressive disclosure and description routing, outcome-bound orchestration, agent lanes and worker fleets, verification discipline, code grading, design and copy as systems, distribution, shipping, a five-tier builder ladder, authoring your own skills, and a ninety-day practice plan. Source Markdown: https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills/tree/main/book. Print edition (PDF): https://skills.suedeai.ai/book/s-tier.pdf

## Workflow skills: from planning a change to grading whether it ships

- [Suede AI Workflow Skills](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-workflow-skills.html): Umbrella router that loads the full Suede AI pack from one install path, picks the specialist for each request, and hands back one scored next move as a runnable prompt.
- [Suede Agent Teams](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-agent-teams.html): Coordinate complex changes and public-repository contribution programs with collision checks, atomic issue leases, review gates, authority boundaries, and a signed handoff.
- [Suede Ops Architecture](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ops-architecture.html): Fix the shape of a system before anyone builds it: entity schema, one write path per entity, every unit of work routed to an automation, an agent, or a human, and each tool marked absorb, keep, or kill with a proof path.
- [Suede Ops Assessment](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ops-assessment.html): Map how work actually happens before anyone designs a system: floor-level interviews with the people doing the work, an inventory of every silo, friction quantified in the operation's own numbers, and opportunities ranked by value against build complexity.
- [Suede AI Eval](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ai-eval.html): Design AI evaluation strategy, failure-mode rubrics, test cases, and acceptance gates.
- [Suede Code](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-code.html): Review and grade code in one pass: P0-P3 findings with file:line evidence, an A-F ship grade across seven lanes with instant-F triggers, plus findings-only and grade-only modes.
- [Suede Graph Flo XR](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-graph-flo-xr.html): Claude Code/macOS Suede Thought Graph shipping search: generate competing plans, score and prune, refute and improve survivors, aggregate compatible lanes, then mutate only the selected plan. Light/standard/deep cap at 55/110/200 calls. Production reads only; never deploys. Other supported agents load the contract and route to direct implementation.
- [Suede Ship Copy](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ship-copy.html): A separate copy-only DAG: blind research lenses, an audit of every agent-generated claim, one message per section, adversarial review, deslop pass, and a publish-readiness gate. Never audits what the requester supplied.
- [Suede CI Gate](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-ci-gate.html): Wire any repo so CI actually gates the merge.
- [Suede Parity Contract](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-parity-contract.html): One domain implemented on many surfaces, held together by a contract generated from the reference surface's live constants. Followers assert against it, existing divergences are pinned with reasons, and a new one fails a test instead of reaching a user.
- [Suede Play Release](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-play-release.html): Google Play delivery where every claim is a readback: credential preflight against the live API, AAB signature and versionCode verification, promote instead of re-upload, staged rollout, and a track read that shows whether the release landed staged or complete.
- [Suede Clip to Guide](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-clip-to-guide.html): Turn a clip or transcript into a clip-to-guide funnel package with rights routing.
- [Suede Design](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-design.html): Read-only whole-flow and UI diff reviews, plus authorized builds with existing brand, tokens, hierarchy, accessibility, reference restyling and rendered visual QA.
- [Suede Component Lab](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-component-lab.html): Dev-only workbenches importing real components with synthetic states, stress fixtures and live variants, isolated from production data and routes.
- [Suede Interface Explain](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-interface-explain.html): Read-only explanations of interface mechanisms, with source locations, state transitions and rendered observations distinguished from inference.
- [Suede Copy](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-copy.html): Conversion and SEO copy in one writing lane: headline formulas, persuasion frameworks, brand voice, answer-first copy for AI search, and an anti-slop gate.
- [Suede Slop Stop](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-deslop.html): Context-aware anti-slop cleanup or findings-only audit that preserves facts, voice, house style, and intentional phrasing, invents nothing, and never claims to identify authorship.
- [Suede SEO Audit](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-seo-audit.html): SEO, AEO, GEO, AI EO, metadata, schema, link, and crawlability audit.
- [Suede Visibility Grader](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-visibility-grader.html): Grade any public page for findability, first-screen clarity, CTA pull, proof, and AI citation readiness.
- [Suede Site Alchemy](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-site-alchemy.html): Turn a page into a conversion engine with funnel and friction analysis.
- [Suede Launch Packaging](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/suede-launch-packaging.html): Ship work as a launch people can actually install.
- [Site to iOS App](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/site-to-ios-app.html): Convert any website or web app into an App Store-ready iOS app plan or shell: URL audit, App Store 4.2 wrapper-risk gate, Capacitor or native-shell strategy, native value requirements, QA matrix, and an explicit release gate.
- [Android App Factory](https://skills.suedeai.ai/skills/android-app-factory.html): Plan or build a native Android app end to end from a keyword: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose scaffolding, Play Billing, Play Store screenshots and ASO listing copy, Data Safety disclosure, signing, and Google Play Console release.

## MCP server

- Suede AI Skills MCP: Optional Model Context Protocol server for skill routing and workflow plans, live A-F page audits for Google and AI search, copy checks against the house rules, install guidance, and grading and QA checklists. 12 tools, 7 resources, 5 prompts, a suede://skill/{name} template for every SKILL.md, dependency-free stdio. Source: https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills/blob/main/mcp/suede-skills-mcp.mjs

## What the skills deliver

Suede skills organize work, generate reports, improve public docs, and prepare review material. Private files stay on your machine, and every external action runs only on a workflow the operator approves.

## Source and citation guide

- [AI Instructions](https://skills.suedeai.ai/ai-instructions/): Site identity, authoritative sources and citation guidance.

## Creator training

Jason Colapietro’s training includes Claude Academy / Anthropic badges in the Claude API, Claude Code, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Claude with Amazon Bedrock and Claude on Google Cloud. His search training includes HubSpot Academy’s AEO Fundamentals and Semrush Academy certificates in AI search, keyword research, on-page SEO, local SEO and digital PR. IBM SkillsBuild covers prompt engineering; Google Skills and Databricks Academy cover generative AI. Seven Microsoft Learn module achievements cover Azure AI Agents, Foundry IQ, Visual Studio Code, Microsoft 365, workflows and Microsoft Agent Framework.
Individual course awards and Microsoft Learn module achievements: https://seo.suedeai.ai/evidence#training-credentials
